title: Senate Panel Has Obtained Copy of Fauci’s Government Cellphone
summary: The development comes as a Senate committee prepares to vote Thursday on whether to hold Dr. Anthony S. Fauci in contempt of Congress for refusing to answer questions at a hearing.
